title: Test the focused Node refusal for ReportedSuccess, the one-call form, and Build's Detached/Cwd-to-root label parity
outcome: Tests cover (a) a ReportedSuccess focused Node run with rejected records ("no native terminal exit observed; <guard> validation rejected"), (b) the one-call form's refusal summary, and (c) a Build whose records lack `detached` or stage `cwd` still reading "root validation rejected".
acceptance: Test the focused Node refusal for ReportedSuccess, the one-call form, and Build's Detached/Cwd-to-root label parity is done
